entries.content_plain: PSALM 15 Psa 15:1-5 . Those who are fit for communion with God may be known by a conformity to His law, which is illustrated in various important particulars. 1. abide-- or, "sojourn" (compare Psa 5:4 ), where it means under God's protection here, as ( Psa 23:6 , 27:4 , 6 ) communion. tabernacle-- seat of the ark ( 2Sa 6:17 ), the symbol of God's presence. holy hill-- (Compare Psa 2:6 ).

All gains made by the wrongful loss of others are forbidden. taketh reward, &c.-- The innocent would not otherwise be condemned (compare Ex 23:8 ; De 16:19 ).
